root_text:
There is no vaccine for the HMPV virus. Its treatment is symptomatic. Doctors prescribe paracetamol for fever and gargles for nasal congestion.
https://t.co/HPSClqy6mr
Tabassum Banagarwala reports on why doctors are not panicking over #HMPV
